findings.what: `body_rows - 1` underflows when `body_rows` is 0 (panic in debug, usize::MAX window in release), whereas the removed loop handled a zero-height body by returning 1.

The removed loop fit lines against the full `body_rows` (same budget `max_scroll_offset` passes to `tail_window_start`), so fitting against `body_rows - 1` shrinks the backward page by up to one row and changes ctrl-u/page-up behaviour in a commit labelled a pure refactor.
